source_title: MEK inhibitors for neurofibromatosis type 1 manifestations: Clinical evidence and consensus
claim_text: Combining a MEK inhibitor with an mTOR, MNK, BRD4 or MET inhibitor produced tumor regression with synergistic responses in preclinical NF1 MPNST models.
notes: Full text (PMC9629420, HTML). Statement made by the de Blank 2022 review citing refs 50-53 (Lock 2016, Malone 2014, De Raedt 2014, Peacock 2018).
